views.definition:
SELECT b.id,
    b.name,
    b.slug,
    b.summary,
    b.date_label,
    s.name AS site,
    t.name AS building_type
   FROM ((buildings b
     JOIN sites s ON ((s.id = b.site_id)))
     JOIN building_types t ON ((t.id = b.type_id)))
  WHERE (b.status = 'published'::text);
